episodes.synopsis: After the fiasco involving the Lord of Terror, the Goddess Technical Helpline is missing important information including Keiichi Morisato's wish.
episodes.title: Ah! I Wish... Once More!

episodes.synopsis: With Christmas approaching, Sayoko Mishima desires to spend her time with the only man on campus who does not appear to "worship" her, that being Keiichi.
episodes.title: Ah! The Beleaguered Queen of Vengeance!

episodes.synopsis: While Keiichi and Belldandy are working at the convenience store, the town is covered with the single color of Christmas. Keiichi, remembering that Belldandy has been with him for about a year decides to get her a present.
episodes.title: Ah! I Offer These Feelings on Christmas Eve!

episodes.synopsis: Keiichi, Belldandy, and the others attend Sayoko's Christmas party.
episodes.title: Ah! I Want to Fill the World with Happiness!

episodes.synopsis: Hikozaemon Otaki fixes the scooter of Satoko Yamano who is being harassed by Toshiyuki and falls in love with her.
episodes.title: Ah! Well-Matched Vibes of Love!

episodes.synopsis: Keiichi receives his first love letter from an underclassman
episodes.title: Ah! Is That Jealouy?!

episodes.synopsis: Keiichi and Belldandy look at photos they have taken recently.
episodes.title: Ah! I Shall Grant Your Wish!

episodes.synopsis: Ignoring Belldandy's feelings, Urd, Skuld, and Peorth compete to see which of them is most suited to serve Keiichi.
episodes.title: Ah! I Want to Be of Use to You!

episodes.synopsis: After reading a romantic comic book, Peorth wishes to go on a date with Keiichi.
episodes.title: Ah! The Goddesses Go Head to Head on a Date!

episodes.synopsis: Peorth continues to vie for Keiichi's affections while feeding him food she prepared.
episodes.title: Ah! I Just Can't Say It!

episodes.synopsis: Toraichi Tamiya and Otaki suddenly announce to the Auto Club that they have to leave town.
episodes.title: Ah! Grasp Your Dream with Your Own Hands!

episodes.synopsis: Troubadour, the plum blossom spirit who once was Urd's lover, appears, urging to reunite with Urd.
episodes.title: Ah! A Goddess's Tears and His Dream!

episodes.synopsis: After betting that Urd cannot ride a ride, Skuld is proven wrong, and thus relinquishes her ice cream as her wager.
episodes.title: Ah! Let Those Feelings Awaken

episodes.synopsis: Skuld's feelings of affection towards Sentaro awakens her magical powers
episodes.title: Ah! My Darling Cupid!

episodes.synopsis: Marller surprisingly visits the onsen resort along with Keiichi, Belldandy, Urd, and Skuld.
episodes.title: Ah! I'm Half Goddess, Half Demon?!

episodes.synopsis: Belldandy philosophizes what would happen Urd's demon and goddess halves remain split, knowing that would cause Urd to self-destruct.
episodes.title: Ah! Shimmer Without Fear of the Darkness!

episodes.synopsis: Even though Urd has reunified her halves, she bares a dissociative identity disorder, as her demon halves suffers memory loss.
episodes.title: Ah! The Chair of Demonkind Descends!

episodes.synopsis: Hild pays a visit to a reminiscent Marller, who is dissatisfied of working at a convenience store.
episodes.title: Ah! Do Demons Have Any Dignity?!

episodes.synopsis: Marller has revived three female rodent ninjas in another attempt to attack Belldandy.
episodes.title: Ah! The Love of a Goddess Saves the Ninja!

episodes.synopsis: Everyone seems to show up asking to store items at the temple, creating a bit of a crush. In an effort to make more room, Skuld creates a device to double the storage space in a room.
episodes.title: Ah! It Doesn't Matter Where, So Long as We're Together!

episodes.synopsis: After three days, Belldandy returns from heaven but discovers that she has been issued a demon license instead of a goddess license.
episodes.title: Ah! Would It Be Okay If I Were a Demon?!

episodes.synopsis: It is shown that Keiichi and Hild are lovers, confusing the three goddesses that Keiichi may be under demonic control.
episodes.title: Ah! The Goddess's Confession!
